title: The Thinking Behind PX: How CKPC Properties Designs Spaces Around People Experience
metaDescription: People Experience (PX) is CKPC Properties' design philosophy — placing everyday usability, movement, and interaction at the centre of every building. See how PX shapes Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Road, Bengaluru.
h1: The Thinking Behind (PX): Designing Spaces Around People Experience

blocks.text: People Experience (PX) is about how spaces make life easier, richer, and more intuitive. It brings together community and connection, and facilitates better everyday living. Rather than being an add-on, PX forms the foundation of CKPC’s approach to design and development — and it is the philosophy behind every decision made at CKPC Heart of Harmony , from the vehicle-free podium to the private sky garden terraces on every third floor.

CKPC Properties approaches development with a clear premise: buildings are only as good as how they are used. This thinking has shaped its People Experience (PX) philosophy, a framework that places everyday usability, movement, and interaction at the centre of design.

People Experience looks at how spaces can function over time, across different users and evolving needs. PX is a planning approach applied from the ground up. It focuses on how people move through spaces, how they interact with their surroundings, and how environments support both individual and collective use. This means decisions are not limited to unit sizes or built-up areas, but extend to access, light, ventilation, and shared infrastructure. The intent is to reduce friction in everyday life, whether it is a shorter walk to amenities, better air quality indoors, or clearer zoning between private and social spaces.
How PX Works in CKPC’s Commercial Projects

In CKPC’s commercial projects, PX translates into high-performance work environments. Developments such as 360° Business Park in Electronic City are planned as integrated campuses, where infrastructure, amenities, and workspaces are aligned to support productivity and efficiency. Large floor plans allow flexibility for occupiers, while features like centralised systems, open spaces, and employee-focused amenities improve usability throughout the workday.

The focus is not just on leasing space, but on creating work environments that function well at scale — critical for global occupiers managing large teams. This same discipline is visible in CKPC’s long-term commercial relationships with Fortune 100 companies including TCS, Siemens, Bosch, and Merck, who trust CKPC’s approach to deliver workplaces that perform over the long term.
How PX Shapes Heart of Harmony

The same PX philosophy carries into CKPC’s residential developments, where the focus shifts from workplace efficiency to daily-life comfort and community living. At Heart of Harmony on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068, every design decision reflects a PX-driven intent:

items: Vehicle-free podium: The ground-level deck is completely car-free, so residents step out of the lobby into greenery — not a parking ramp. This single design choice fundamentally changes the daily arrival experience.

Private sky garden terraces on every third floor: Rather than concentrating open space at the ground level or roof, garden terraces are distributed across the building, bringing outdoor access closer to every resident. See how these gardens work across the 24-floor tower .
6 homes per floor: Low-density floor plates mean quieter corridors, better cross-ventilation, more natural light, and a sense of community that feels exclusive rather than crowded.

Two-level amenity distribution: Instead of concentrating all amenities in a single clubhouse block, Heart of Harmony distributes them across the podium (outdoor sports and social) and the rooftop terrace (wellness and leisure clubhouse) — improving accessibility and encouraging regular use by all residents.

84% open green space: The site area is predominantly open and landscaped, with walkable pathways, shared spaces, and landscape integration designed to support both interaction and privacy — two key aspects of modern residential living.

blocks.text: To explore the full master plan and how these PX decisions translate into the site layout, tower design, and floor configurations, read the Heart of Harmony master plan .

The idea behind PX is straightforward: design should respond to how people actually live and work. By focusing on movement, interaction, and long-term usability, CKPC shifts the conversation from building spaces to creating environments that perform over time. As expectations from both workplaces and homes continue to evolve, this approach positions PX not as a feature, but as a baseline for designing spaces that remain relevant, functional, and easy to live in.

See how the PX philosophy translates into reality at CKPC Heart of Harmony — where every design decision from the vehicle-free podium to the 40+ amenities across two levels reflects this people-first approach. For an independent buyer’s analysis of how PX thinking translates into the Heart of Harmony living experience, read the CKPC Heart of Harmony review .

items.q: What is People Experience (PX) in real estate?
items.a: People Experience (PX) is a design philosophy developed by CKPC Properties that places the everyday experience of building users at the centre of design decisions — covering how spaces support movement, wellness, social interaction, privacy, and daily convenience. PX is applied from the ground up across both commercial and residential developments.

items.q: What does PX mean in the context of Heart of Harmony?
items.a: At Heart of Harmony, PX means every design decision — from the vehicle-free podium to the private sky garden terraces every three floors, the 6-homes-per-floor layout, and the two-level amenity distribution across podium and rooftop clubhouse — is made around how residents actually live daily, not how the project looks in a brochure. Heart of Harmony is located at Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .

items.q: What are the 8 Pillars of PX at CKPC Properties?
items.a: CKPC’s PX framework is built around eight pillars: movement and accessibility, natural light and ventilation, community and social interaction, privacy and personal space, wellness and active living, sustainability and green integration, everyday convenience, and long-term adaptability. These pillars apply equally to CKPC’s commercial campuses and residential developments including Heart of Harmony.

items.q: How does PX design differ from standard apartment design?
items.a: Standard apartment design focuses on unit size, floor count, and facility count. PX design starts with how people move through the building, how they interact with their neighbours, and how the design reduces friction in everyday life. At Heart of Harmony, this means: zero common walls between apartments, a vehicle-free podium instead of a parking-first ground level, garden terraces every three floors instead of one rooftop garden shared by all, and 6 homes per floor instead of 12–16. Explore the Heart of Harmony floor plans

items.q: Who developed the PX design philosophy?
items.a: The PX (People Experience) philosophy was developed by CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, led by Chirag Purushotam (Managing Director & CEO). It is applied across all CKPC developments — including 360° Business Park in Electronic City (commercial) and Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate (residential).

items.q: Is Heart of Harmony designed for sustainable living?
items.a: Yes. The PX philosophy at Heart of Harmony integrates sustainability through 84% open green space across the site, natural ventilation through zero-common-wall floor plans with 270° panoramic openings, garden terraces bringing greenery to every third floor, and landscaped walkways throughout the vehicle-free podium. These elements reduce dependence on artificial lighting and cooling while improving everyday comfort.

items.q: What does community mean in the context of PX design?
items.a: In PX design, community is not a marketing term — it is a spatial decision. At Heart of Harmony, community is created through deliberate design choices: 6 homes per floor (you share a corridor with 5 neighbours, not 15), a vehicle-free podium where residents gather without cars, social spaces like the amphitheatre, campfire seating, and shared gardens, and a rooftop clubhouse where 137 homes share premium facilities that never feel overcrowded.

items.q: Does CKPC Properties apply PX in their commercial buildings?
items.a: Yes. CKPC’s commercial developments — including 360° Business Park in Electronic City — are planned as integrated campuses with large floor plates, centralised systems, employee-focused amenities, and open spaces aligned to support productivity. Fortune 100 companies including TCS, Siemens, Bosch, Merck, Continental, and Rockwell Automation trust CKPC’s PX-driven approach for their Bengaluru operations.

items.a: Heart of Harmony on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068 is CKPC’s flagship residential demonstration of PX design.
